permitDetails.extractionNotes: Permit number, dates, facility name, address, county, and Facility ID are from the permit cover page: 'AIR PERMIT NO. 10165R03', 'Issue Date: April 15, 2019', 'Expiration Date: June 30, 2024', 'Andale, Inc., 284 Social Circle, Forest City, Rutherford County, North Carolina', 'Facility ID# 8100221'. Address presented here on one line; source lists street on one line and city/county/state on the next. Permit requires permit retention onsite (General Condition 14). Facility-wide diesel fuel oil combusted limit of 599,270 gallons per consecutive 12-month period is in Specific Condition 9.a (avoidance per 15A NCAC 2Q .0315); not mapped to generator-level throughput fields.
